cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Story Turning Point Card
cards.turningPointSkill: connect a fictional lab start scene, turn signal, before path, after path, character reaction, next step, and file-box label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only file box turning point card for one tidepool timekeepers lab page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out a file box, blank page, pencil, and label strip before the paper turning point begins: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a tidepool timekeeper, a pretend chart, and a made-up turn that stays on paper: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write what the timekeeper is checking on the pretend tidepool chart before anything changes: ____________________.
cards.turnSignalPrompt: Turn signal: name the paper clue that tells the timekeeper the plan needs a turn, such as a shell mark or clock dot: ____________________.
cards.beforePathPrompt: Before path: write what the timekeeper was going to do before noticing the turn signal: ____________________.
cards.afterPathPrompt: After path: write the new paper path the timekeeper follows after the signal changes the plan: ____________________.
cards.characterReactionPrompt: Character reaction: write how the timekeeper reacts when the after path makes more sense: ____________________.
cards.nextStepPrompt: Next step: add one calm next step the timekeeper can try on the same pretend lab page: ____________________.
cards.fileBoxLabelPrompt: File-box label: write the short pretend label for this tidepool turning point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads the start scene and turn signal, and the writer fills only the after path blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: place the lab page in the file box with the file-box label ready for later: ____________________.

cards.title: Greenhouse Gear Garden Story Turning Point Card
cards.turningPointSkill: shape a fictional garden helper turning point with a start scene, turn signal, before path, after path, reaction, next step, and file-box label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only file box turning point card for one greenhouse gear garden page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: open the file box, add a blank garden page, and set a pencil beside a file-box label slip: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up a greenhouse gear helper and keep every gear, gate, and garden note pretend on paper: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write what the greenhouse helper is trying to sort with the pretend gear cards: ____________________.
cards.turnSignalPrompt: Turn signal: name the small paper sign that changes the helper's plan, such as a gear notch, gate tag, or vine mark: ____________________.
cards.beforePathPrompt: Before path: write the helper's first plan before the turn signal appears on the page: ____________________.
cards.afterPathPrompt: After path: write the new plan the helper chooses after reading the turn signal: ____________________.
cards.characterReactionPrompt: Character reaction: write one line about how the helper reacts to the changed plan: ____________________.
cards.nextStepPrompt: Next step: add one paper next step that keeps the greenhouse story moving gently: ____________________.
cards.fileBoxLabelPrompt: File-box label: write the short pretend label for this greenhouse gear turning point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the turn signal line, and the writer fills only the character reaction blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck the greenhouse page into the file box with the before path and after path marked for later: ____________________.

cards.afterPathPrompt: After path: write the new paper path the helper follows after noticing the signal: ____________________.

cards.fileBoxLabelPrompt: File-box label: write the short pretend label for this station turning point: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Story Turning Point Card
cards.turningPointSkill: plan a longer fictional revision-ferry turning point by linking start scene, turn signal, before path, after path, character reaction, next step, and file-box label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only file box turning point card for one revision river ferry page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the file box, a blank river ferry page, pencil, and file-box label slip for the paper turning point: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a ferry guide, revision notes, and a made-up river crossing that exists only on the page: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write what the ferry guide is revising, sorting, or carrying before the turning point arrives: ____________________.
cards.turnSignalPrompt: Turn signal: name the revision clue that changes the ferry guide's plan, such as a margin arrow, ferry tag, or crossed note: ____________________.
cards.beforePathPrompt: Before path: write the guide's original paper path before the revision clue changes the plan: ____________________.
cards.afterPathPrompt: After path: write the new path the guide follows after the turn signal points to a better revision choice: ____________________.
cards.characterReactionPrompt: Character reaction: write how the ferry guide reacts when the revised path fits the page: ____________________.
cards.nextStepPrompt: Next step: add one thoughtful next step the guide can write after the turning point: ____________________.
cards.fileBoxLabelPrompt: File-box label: write the short pretend label for this revision river turning point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult rereads the turn signal, and the writer fills only the before path and after path blanks: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the ferry page in the file box with the file-box label and next step ready for later: ____________________.
